title: Eventra
summary: Event ticketing with ticket tiers, QR passes and a door check-in screen.
description: Attendees discover events and buy tickets that become QR passes; organizers watch a live dashboard; door staff scan people in. Rules stop selling past capacity and checking a ticket in twice, and attendees get a reminder the day before.
roles_summary: Attendees sign up. Organizers run events. Door staff check people in.
includes: Live organizer dashboard and a check-in screen
highlights: Rules: no selling past capacity, no double check-in
